featured_reviews.review_text:
VALUE FOR MONEY.👌👌👌

They should expand their place to improve the overall experience of enjoying food.

featured_reviews.name: karuna bangera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajendra is an outlet quite famous amongst the locals serving all the vegetarian fast food options along with the Chinese. They have two outlets on the adjacent lanes in borivali west itself. I had visited the first one situated on punjabi lane where there are few seating arrangements available. Going through the reviews which were hardly any for this outlet so I had to resort to the reviews of the second outlet to know what's their famous option. I found out many reviewers had recommended pizza dosa and jini dosa. Sadly the pizza dosa was missing in this outlet's menu however we still asked for it . The cook was courteous enough to serve us the pizza dosa which was great loaded with cheese and ofcourse the veggies. The dosa base was crisp enough to give that crunch served with the green and white coconut chutney.
Overall rating - 4/5
Needless to say, it's worth the hype and also liked the gesture of the person making the dosa. A very good option at affordable rates.

Food Review – Vijay Dosa & Sandwich, Borivali West

Visited this popular spot in Borivali West with a friend, and we decided to try their sandwiches this time. We had the Mayonnaise Cheese Chilli Toast (₹90) and the Bombay Masala Cheese Toast (₹80) — both were packed with flavours and loaded with cheesy goodness.

The mayo chilli toast had a perfect balance of creaminess and spice, while the Bombay masala toast gave that classic Mumbai street-style feel with a rich, tangy masala twist. The portions were generous, and every bite was satisfying.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves indulgent sandwiches! Looking forward to trying their dosas next time — the menu looked promising.

This is a late review.
I visited this restaurant on 8th May 2026. My both kids had their exams on 8th May and their centre was between Borivali and Dahisar. After exams we had planned to visit the Ganesh temple at Vazira Naka however, before visiting the temple we decided to eat something as we all 4 had skipped our lunch due to exam stress. We saw Veg Treat restaurant located at Vazira Naka at around 5.30 p.m. we thought that we would get good and hygienic food as all Veg Treat restaurant’s usually have we went there in their AC section. The section was completely empty. Kids ordered Pav Bhaji (their favourite) and I and my husband ordered Rava Onion Sada Dosa and Rava Masala Dosa.

The Dosa’s were below average but the most shocking part was the Pav Bhaji. For the 1st time I saw my 17 year old’s leave the Pav Bhaji without finishing it. Disappointment was quite visible on their faces. Frankly speaking I could not believe that Pav Bhaji from a restaurant would not taste well. So to confirm even I tasted a spoon of Bhaji and was shocked with the taste. Even the Pav Bhaji at road side stalls are 1000 times better tasting then the Pav Bhaji at this restaurant. Total wastage of money as we were charged extra for sitting in AC.

My daughter ate only 1 pav out of the 2 pav’s that is given with the Bhaji in first round and left the remaining pav and Bhaji. And in the other plate which is of my son’s since, he was hungry he somehow ate half the Bhaji but he preferred to eat more of the pav as it is then with Bhaji.

This is the first time that they left Pav Bhaji at all. But that was not the end my kids then ordered 1 lemon soda (salted) and 1 Lime juice. When I called for bill 1 fly fell into my daughters Lime juice in AC section which was still alive. I insisted that I should not be charged for the Lime juice which they were not agreeing instead they were insisting that they will give another Lime juice. However, our mood specially of my kids was as it is off due to bad quality of food and on top of it this fly incident. We didn’t want to have any other thing to eat from this restaurant. Infact, we were going to take parcel for dinner good we didn’t order.

After lot of discussion with the staff finally they didn’t charge for the Lime juice.  However, when I told that they should infact not charge me for Pav Bhaji or should charge half for it as it was not at all good and had only strong flavour of garlic and was sour in taste nothing like a Pav Bhaji but they completely ignored my request. They did not even bother about the review shared by me.

The restaurant is owned by one person and managed by another. The management is pathetic. In fact wanted to speak with the owner hope he sees this review. I have also taken photos and videos (with the fly) in which the scanner of the restaurant placed on the table can been seen. I will upload the photos and videos also on the site if needed.

Save yourself from going in this restaurant. Wish I could give minus points as a review.

The smoked Pav Bhaji is a must-try because it has a rich, smoky flavor and tastes amazing with their buttery pav. Their Pizza Lasagna is also very different and perfect for people who like trying fusion dishes.

The ambience is casual and comfortable, making it a good place to hang out with friends and family. The service is quick, and the staff is friendly and helpful with recommendations.

What truly stood out for me was the Kothmir (daniya) Pav — easily one of the most flavorful. Rich in taste, perfectly balanced, and something I would happily go back for again.

If you’re in Borivali, this place deserves a visit.

Highly recommended for pav bhaji lovers looking to try something beyond the ordinary.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Ma Anjani Pav Bhaji at Korakendra, Borivali and tried their famous 3-in-1 Pav Bhaji, and it was a really satisfying experience. This combo includes three different bhajis – Black, Red and Green, served with big, soft 3 pav pieces, fried papad, buttermilk, and a fresh onion-tomato salad. The total cost was around ₹400, which felt reasonable considering the quantity and variety.
Among the three, I absolutely loved the Black Pav Bhaji – it was rich, flavourful, slightly smoky and very different from the regular pav bhaji you get everywhere. The Red bhaji was nicely spicy and the Green one was fresh and herby, giving a nice balance to the plate.
I also tried the Masala Khichiya Papad, which was topped with fresh chopped onions, tomatoes and masala. It was very crisp, fresh and perfectly seasoned – a great starter.
The overall presentation, freshness and taste were really good. Everything felt hygienic and well-prepared. The combination of pav bhaji with buttermilk and salad makes the meal feel complete and not too heavy.
If you’re in Borivali and want to try something different from regular pav bhaji, this place is definitely worth visiting.
Highly recommended for pav bhaji lovers, especially for the Black Pav Bhaji 👍
